Flow sample rig.

Seats: main (keep), worker (fresh), reviewer (fresh).
main hands a task to worker with `atrium prompt worker "<task>"`.
worker closes with `atrium done ok "<report>"`; the board passes it to a new reviewer.
reviewer closes with `atrium done ok "<notes>"` (goes to main) or `atrium done rejected "<what to change>"` (goes back to a new worker, at most 2 times per case; the third time it goes to main).
A seat may only send plain messages to the seats in its "may" list.
